avis.titre: Stop putting coconut oil in everything.
avis.texte: This is not a review but a statement- see all the reviews saying this caused the worst breakout of ppls life? STOP putting coconut oil derivatives in face products. For many coconut oil is the absolute WORST cystic acne causing hellacious nightmare substance and they may not even know it. Women, READ the ingredients for every product that causes a breakout and you might be surprised to find a pattern- that they all contain coconut oil or some derivitive of. Anything with "coco" is from coconut oil. I cant get this stuff anywhere near my face, not hair products, hand lotion, I cant consume it in food, nothing. Im writing this because Im so sick to death of seeing it in practically every single product- makeup, skincare, face/body wash when it is so comedogenic it should come with a warning label. This face wash is marketed to address acne and the first several ingredients come from coconut oil!! Lol is that a joke?

avis.titre: Cleared up my hormonal acne and rosacea!
avis.texte: While I've always struggled with hormonal acne, earlier this year I was also diagnosed with rosacea. I've been looking around for a face wash to treat both my acne and rosacea without using salicylic acid and benzoyl peroxide. Which has been a hard task but I finally found one that has been so helpful with both. It calms the redness and flareups in my skin, giving me a more even tone and texture while also calming the hormonal acne that I always seem to have. I was not expecting it to work as quickly as it did. I've been using this for maybe 14 days and I've already noticed an incredible difference in my skin. It is a little on the expensive side, but for how quickly it worked and how well it works, I'm more than happy to pay that price especially considering I've been using it twice a day for two weeks and I've barely made a dent in the bottle. It does have a slight smell due to the sulfur that it uses as the active ingredient in the treatment, but it's nothing overbearing especially if you're rinsing your face off well after each wash. If you struggle with rosacea and acne, this is a must have in your routine!

avis.titre: Fantastic for teen acne and sebaceous filaments!
avis.texte: This product has worked better than anything else for my teen daughters acne. We had tried many other products with little success. It also really clears your sebaceous filaments on your nose. I've used it too and it works well. Does not irritate y sensitive skin.

I've tried so many different actives to help acne and this is the one that actually works. I was worried it would dry my skin out but it's really gentle and keeps me balanced. Really love this product!

This is by far the best cleanser I've ever used. I'm 20 years old with sensitive combination skin (mostly dry especially in the colder seasons but sometimes oily on my forehead). I don't have bad acne, just a few pimples that appear sometimes (usually hormonal). I work at Ulta, so I've tried MANY different types of cleansers. This is the only cleanser that gets rid of my pimples within 2 washes. I'm truly obsessed and have been using for about 3-4 months now. This can also be used as a mask. It doesn't leave my skin feeling irritated, tight, dry, or stripped, like I've had issues with in the past with other cleansers. If you have stubborn pimples and are looking for something new I would definitely give this a try! I've recommended this to so many people who have also ended up loving it. It's 100% worth the price in my opinion. Make sure you're applying on wet skin! It definitely makes a difference. You only need a very small amount, this will last you months. I would give it about a week or two of consistent use to see results. The only thing I don't like is the smell, but I can get past that with how amazing my skin looks and feels. I live by this stuff!!
